text: Even for such limited set of features application contains major bugs. My streak was reset even though it's visible in the calendar as non interrupted during past several days.
author: Viacheslav Kotrakhov
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback. Sorry to hear about the streak reset issue and understand your frustration. We're actively investigating this bug and working on a fix. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention and will update the app as soon as possible. If you'd like to provide more details, please contact us at contact.adrienblc@gmail.com.
